measurements.scope: Conditional WGS84 geographic floor between the source-described 67 and 76 degrees N gates. Summer near-surface observations in 1978 and 1979; exact gate dates and common fixed layer unknown. The author extends historical Baffin Current naming north to Lady Ann Strait. No simultaneous connected axis, whole-current length or guaranteed physical minimum established. Lancaster Sound intrusion and meanders are not reconstructed.
